name: Ladies Dress Vest
desc:
This is one of our newest styles! Our Dress Vest is very simple with clean-cut edges with the lapel turned suede outward. There is one real buffalo nickel to secure the vest. This style is perfect for the office with a nice blouse or on the motorcycle with a bikini! However you prefer, this vest has it all. Soft, quality and hand washable.

Custom color requests are accepted!

Please contact us for a current inventory due to a constantly changing stock.

name: Ladies V-Neck Club Vest
desc:
Our Ladies' V-Neck Vest is a beautiful option for those who like the trimmed, unfinished bottom, finished with real buffalo nickels. The v-neck is a flattering style for all shapes and sizes with the princess seam. This comes standard without side laces, but can be custom ordered if desired. Made from deerskin, this is a simple but versatile vest, perfect for riding a motorcycle or horse or an evening out on the town!

Custom color requests accepted.

name: Moccasins - Slipper
desc:
Our Slipper is a low rise, slip-on, slightly adjustable shoe made for around the house. They can be custom ordered with the optional glued-in leather insole or bison robe. (Pictured is with the buffalo robe insole)

  • +$35 leather insole
  • +$100 robe

name: Unisex English Bridle Belt
desc:
Our belts are hand cut from top quality, heavy cow hide that is built to last. All belts are stocked with a heavy buckles, but can be interchanged for personal a buckle. Another bonus is that these belts are easily downsized for weight loss!

The types of leather:

English Bridle: English Bridle Leather belts have a beautiful, smooth, tight grain, giving it a more finished dressy look. The compact fibers make this slightly stiff, we use this leather for the Real Nickel Belts.

We can add almost any rivet, concho, or other decoration to these belts. Find more information on our custom page.

name: Maverick Shirt
desc:
Our Maverick shirt is a quality deerskin Boone style product. This shirt is modeled after the classic Boone but without the fringe, double collar to weigh it down for riding, with zippered cuffs and zippers on the sides to be able to change in and out of it easily. The Maverick is considered a unisex shirt, however the sleeve length will vary for everyone, so we suggest special ordering it so that you get the best fit.

Please contact us for current inventory!

name: Clip-On Hip Bags
desc:
Our hip bags have been our bestsellers since we first started producing them. They are made from deerskin, making them soft and durable. They clip onto your belt loops with heavy-duty horse tack clips that last. A braided leather strap can also be purchased to transition it to a traditional purse. Our regular sized bags come with a cast buffalo nickel, and all large bags come with a real antique buffalo nickel.

Decorations can be added to a bag of your choosing after the purchase of a bag.

*Please contact us for our current inventory, being as it is constantly changing.

name: Boone Shirt
desc:
The Boone deerskin shirt is a loose-fitting, classic frontier styled shirt with zippers on both sides of the shirt to facilitate wearing. This is a unisex shirt with the option of with or without fringe and a lace up neck with a single layered collar (you can request snaps for the collar to keep it in place). The sleeves are also long enough to unroll if your hands are cold. This is a quality shirt; whether you are riding a motorcycle, hunting or wanting to just look great!

Please contact us for current inventory or special request!

name: Deerskin Jacket
desc:
Our biker styled jacket is a quality piece made with the rider in mind with a classic look and clean style in addition to outside and inside pockets. Each jacket can be custom designed with or without fringe, pockets and the side laces to give a tighter fit around the waist. Our jackets aren't considered unisex. We suggest that you custom order your jacket so that you get the fit and design that you want.

Other features

  • no lining
  • long sleeves with zipper and snap cuff
  • double finished collar snaps added
  • well-fitting
  • slight shirttail back

Our jackets should be custom ordered for the best fit, please contact us for more information!

name: Ladies Piped Club Vest
desc:
Our ladies club vest is a nice option for those who like the trimmed, unfinished bottom but not the ragged edges. It is a great option if you want side laces or to put patches on it. This vest comes with or without side laces. The club vest is a flattering style for all shapes and sizes with the princess seam. Made from deerskin, this is a simple but versatile vest. Plus you can add almost any color for a classy yet fun addition to your vest!

*This vest will need to be custom ordered for your color choices*
